title: On Improving the road before the rains
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：improve　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 improve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the keeper ① improved the road before the rains in silence, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② improves the road before the rains twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ improve the road before the rains at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ improved the road before the rains before — a line in the calendar for January 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Improving the road before the rains in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ improve the marks of every child twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Improve the marks of every child at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ improves the marks of every child in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ improved the road before the rains again when nobody else would.

⑩ To improve the road before the rains, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody improves the road before the rains twice over again and somebody must improve the road before the rains in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 改进（一般过去式 improved the road before the rains：1982 年守夜人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 改进（一般现在 improves the road before the rains：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 改进（不定式 to improve the road before the rains：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 改进（过去完成时 had improved the road before the rains：1976 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 改进（动名词 improving the road before the rains 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 提高（improve the marks of every child：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去提高把每个孩子的成绩提上去）
G. v. 提高（improve the marks of every child：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 改进（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 improves the marks of every child，而母亲又一次 improved the road before the rains）

answers.why: improve 意为“改进”，1982 年守夜人一言不发地改进雨季前把那条路修好一些，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 improved。
improve 意为“改进”，自那以后守夜人来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 improves。
improve 意为“改进”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯改进雨季前把那条路修好一些”，此处为不定式 to improve the road before the rains。
improve 意为“改进”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人改进过，故用过去完成时 had improved。
improve 意为“改进”，守夜人说“改进雨季前把那条路修好一些这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 improving the road before the rains 作主语。
improve 意为“提高”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去提高把每个孩子的成绩提上去”，should ever 之后用原形 improve the marks of every child。
improve 意为“提高”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻提高把每个孩子的成绩提上去（improve the marks of every child at once），以后再也不要提起。
improve 意为“改进”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例提高把每个孩子的成绩提上去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 improves。
improve 意为“改进”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地改进雨季前把那条路修好一些，用一般过去式 improved 叙述。
improve 意为“改进”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要改进雨季前把那条路修好一些，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，守夜人一言不发地改进雨季前把那条路修好一些；钟楼里每一个过路人都说这是头一回。（improved the road before the rains）
多年以后，守夜人仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（improves the road before the rains）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯改进雨季前把那条路修好一些这件事本身。（to improve the road before the rains）
早在 1976 年就有人改进雨季前把那条路修好一些，一月那天年历上的一行字就是证据。（had improved the road before the rains）
守夜人说过，一言不发地改进雨季前把那条路修好一些这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（improving the road before the rains 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻提高把每个孩子的成绩提上去，以后再也不要提起。（improve the marks of every child，祈使句）

Three years on, the keeper still improves the road before the rains twice over without being asked.

Somebody had improved the road before the rains long before 1989, and the line in the calendar for January proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 improve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the keeper improved the road before the rains in silence, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper improves the road before the rains twice over whenever the tower asks.
Improving the road before the rains in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever improve the marks of every child twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower improves the marks of every child in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother improved the road before the rains again, and the tower remembered that half.
